entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Test results in AzDO report unqualified method names after MSTest migration #55123
  • Add 10.0 branches to Get-BranchMirrorStatus.ps1 and plan removal after 8.x/9.x EOL #55120
  • macOS .pkg: dnx installed by two overlapping component packages (SDK dev and sharedhost) #55116
    11.0-preview7

Closed

  • [Unstable][Linux/Mac] There is an error "Cannot access a disposed object." when press "Ctrl + C" to shut down the application #55096
  • dotnet test output can be hard to navigate #51952
  • Rename runner-agnostic `SDKCustomXUnit*` Helix infrastructure to a runner-neutral name #55094
  • Flaky test: PostActionTests.AddProjectToSolution_WithOutputRelativePath - .sln file not found #54942
  • Test failure - AllWebProjectsRestoreAndBuild fails with Unbalanced Condition for F# MVC templates #40073
    10.0.1xx
  • [Known Build Error] AoT macOS: WasmAoTPublishIntegrationTest fails with NETSDK1147 (wasm-tools workload not installed) #54869
  • [Known Build Error] ProjectUpdateInProcTests.ProjectAndSourceFileChange_AddProjectReference timing failure #53661
  • Test failing in CI: Microsoft.DotNet.Tests.PackagedCommandTests.CanInvokeToolWhosePackageNameIsDifferentFromDllName : `Tool with output name!` #51146
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.FileWatcherTests.DeleteSubfolder has flaky test assertion #49233
  • Build (arm64): Unable to load the service index for source https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/dnceng/public/_packaging #55118
  • Build: MSB3894 IOException 'process cannot access the file' copying GenAPI.Task satellite assemblies #55119
  • [Known Build Error] build fails: GetAssemblyAttributes IOException - Microsoft.DotNet.ApiCompat.Task.dll in use by another process #54864
  • Run-file tests failing with "The project file could not be loaded." #54819
  • File-based apps should handle deleted artifacts directory #55056

PullRequests

Created

  • Shave 200+ms off cost to `POST` telemetry using proper connection str #55127
  • `dotnetup`: Use connection string rather than an ikey #55126
  • Fix NullReferenceException in `dotnet sln remove` for .slnx files with invalid path #55125
  • Fix dotnet pack failing when output path ends with "dotnet" #55124
  • Rename `SDKCustomCreateTestWorkItemsWithTestExclusion` to `CreateHelixTestWorkItems` #55122
  • Migrate DefineStaticWebAssets to multithreaded task execution #55117
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.3.0-preview.26325.12 to 4.3.0-preview.26351.2 #55115
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Bump Microsoft.WixToolset.Sdk from 6.0.3-dotnet.4 to 6.0.3-dotnet.6 #55114
    dependencies, dependabot: main

Merged

  • Fix ObjectDisposedException in UnixProcessReaper during Ctrl+C shutdown #55121
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #54995
  • docs: explain why publishing a solution is discouraged #53693
  • Rename runner-agnostic `SDKCustomXUnit*` Helix infrastructure to a runner-neutral name #55099
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55113
  • Fix intermittent ApiCompat.Task build failure due to file lock race condition #55109
  • Migrate WriteAppConfigWithSupportedRuntime to IMultiThreadableTask #53957
  • Use `lazy` install root lookup in `dotnetup` to avoid duplicated environment lookups #54982

Updated

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55000
  • Add --allow-prerelease and --no-sdk-version options to dotnet new globaljson template #54133
  • Skip full Build for AOT publish, use Compile instead #54515
    breaking-change
  • Dotnetup: add `env` command to update PathPreference mode #54545
  • Resolve the versioned SDK directory in the Native AOT CLI #55110
  • Better error when workload set version uses package version format #54929
  • Do not report `CA2007` for pattern-based `await using` and `await foreach` #55036
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55104
  • Fix `dotnet sln` failing to parse `.slnf` files with unescaped backslashes in path #54622
  • Delete `.merge_file_JsDg5L` #55112
  • Enable method-level parallelization for true unit test projects #55090
  • Fix check for a project being properly loaded #54983
  • Replace branch-mirror-status prompt file with PowerShell script #55111
  • POC: Time-based Helix test scheduling with AzDO history #54939
  • Fix `dotnet build file.cs` with MSBuild logger options #54172
    Area-CLI
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55031
  • Pack RID-specific tool pointer packages with DotnetToolSettings.xml under tools/any/any #55107
    Area-Tools
  • Use PortableRuntimeIdentifierGraph in ToolPackage #55046
    breaking-change, Area-Tools, needs-breaking-change-doc-created
